criteria.requirement: Add CharsetMatch.transcode(encoding="utf_8", *, errors="strict", bom="codec") returning output bytes and unencodable codepoint count. Strict must fail on unrepresentable characters; replace/ignore explicitly report losses without counting literal question marks. Support codec/strip/add BOM policy for UTF8/16/32 and reject adding unsupported BOMs. Reuse current encoding-declaration rewriting, preserve empty input and keep old output default/cache behavior independent from the new strategy.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
